title: Twisted tester transcript
statement: Let a nonadaptive tester make $r$ queries to a domain $Omega$ with sign-valued answers. Given a seed, a transcript of optional answers, and a sign-valued phase function on the domain, form a new transcript by multiplying each present answer by the phase at its queried point; at positions with no query or no answer, leave the transcript absent.
